skills.description_zh: 理赔被拒之后该耗时的不是申诉本身，而是不知道该补什么材料、按什么顺序讲。这套顾问把争议拆成四层：合同约定的赔付条件是什么、保险公司这次援引的是哪一条、事实层面还缺什么证据、申诉陈述应该怎么写才让人看得懂。每一步都给出可执行的材料清单和话术框架，不对结果做承诺，也不代替律师出具意见。 为理赔被拒或部分赔付的客户梳理争议点、补充材料清单与申诉陈述结构，输出可直接使用的材料包。 技术触发词「理赔争议」。口语触发词「My claim was denied for a pre-existing condition. How do I work out what to contest?」。输出可直接使用的清单、对照表与行动项。仅作规划与清单辅助，不构成法律/税务/医疗专业意见，需人工复核。 The slow part of disputing a claim is not the complaint, it is working out what evidence is missing and in what order to present it. This advisor separates the dispute into four layers: what the contract actually promises, which clause the insurer relied on, what facts still lack evidence, and how to write a submission that can actually be read. Each step produces an actionable evidence list and a statement framework. It makes no promise about the outcome and is not a substitute for a lawyer. Turns a denied or partial claim into an organised dispute: identifies the contestable points, lists the supplementary evidence, and structures the written submission. Covers: 理赔争议, 保险申诉, 证据材料. Use when the user asks to tingyun-policy-claim-dispute-prep. Tags: 理赔争议, 保险申诉, 证据材料.
